# Nis2Shield.AspNetCore

> Security-First Middleware for ASP.NET Core NIS2 Compliance

## What is this?
A NuGet package that adds NIS2 compliance features to ASP.NET Core applications:
- **Forensic Logging**: HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON logs
- **PII Protection**: Automatic IP anonymization and field encryption
- **Active Defense**: Rate limiting, session guard, Tor blocking
- **Multi-SIEM**: Native Elasticsearch, Splunk HEC, Datadog connectors
- **Webhooks**: Real-time alerts to Slack, Teams, Discord

## Quick Setup

```csharp
// Program.cs
builder.Services.AddNis2Shield(builder.Configuration);
app.UseNis2Shield();
```

```json
// appsettings.json
{
  "Nis2": {
    "IntegrityKey": "your-hmac-key",
    "Logging": { "Enabled": true, "AnonymizeIp": true },
    "ActiveDefense": { "RateLimitEnabled": true, "BlockTorExitNodes": true },
    "SessionGuard": { "Enabled": true, "SubnetTolerance": 24 }
  }
}
```

## Core Components
- `Nis2Middleware`: Main pipeline component
- `ForensicLogger`: Creates signed log entries
- `SessionGuard`: Detects session hijacking
- `RateLimiter`: Sliding window rate limiting
- `TorBlocker`: Blocks Tor exit nodes
- `ISiemConnector`: Interface for SIEM integration
- `IWebhookNotifier`: Interface for webhook notifications

## SIEM Configuration
```json
{
  "Nis2": {
    "Siem": {
      "Enabled": true,
      "Provider": "Splunk",
      "Endpoint": "https://splunk:8088/services/collector",
      "ApiKey": "your-hec-token"
    }
  }
}
```

## Webhook Configuration
```json
{
  "Nis2": {
    "Webhooks": {
      "Enabled": true,
      "Targets": [
        {
          "Name": "Slack Alerts",
          "Url": "https://hooks.slack.com/xxx",
          "Provider": "Slack",
          "Events": ["rate_limit_exceeded", "tor_node_blocked"]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## NIS2 Articles Addressed
- Art. 21.2.h: Cryptographic integrity (HMAC-SHA256)
- Art. 21.2.e: Rate limiting for DoS prevention
- Art. 21.2.a: Session hijacking detection
- Art. 21.2.g: PII encryption and anonymization

## Ecosystem
Part of NIS2 Shield: Django, Spring, Express, React, Infrastructure.
